recoveryWorkouts.title: Light Active Recovery
recoveryWorkouts.description: Gentle movement to promote blood flow and recovery

exercises.name: Easy Walk or Light Jog
exercises.instruction: Very easy movement to warm up. Should feel effortless and restorative.
exercises.definition: Gentle cardiovascular warm-up to elevate heart rate and body temperature without stress

exercises.name: Light Cardio (Bike/Walk/Swim)
exercises.instruction: Maintain a pace where you can hold a conversation easily. This promotes blood flow without adding stress.
exercises.definition: Zone 2 cardiovascular work that promotes recovery through increased blood flow and metabolic clearance
formCues: This is recovery work, not training

exercises.name: Hip Circles
exercises.notes: Stand tall, draw large circles with knee
exercises.instruction:
Stand tall, hold support if needed
Lift one knee, keep it bent
Draw large circles with the knee
10 circles clockwise
10 circles counterclockwise
Feel hip joint moving through full range
Switch legs and repeat
exercises.definition: Comprehensive mobility sequence targeting major joints and movement patterns to restore range of motion and reduce stiffness

exercises.name: Leg Swings (Front-to-Back)
exercises.notes: Hold support, swing leg forward and back, then side to side
exercises.instruction:
Hold onto wall or support
Swing leg forward and back
10 swings forward/back
Then swing leg side to side
10 swings side to side
Feel hip opening in both planes
Switch legs and repeat
exercises.definition: Comprehensive mobility sequence targeting major joints and movement patterns to restore range of motion and reduce stiffness

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.instruction:
Stand tall, arms extended to sides
Make large circles forward
10 circles forward
Then reverse direction
10 circles backward
Feel shoulders moving freely
Keep circles large and controlled
exercises.definition: Comprehensive mobility sequence targeting major joints and movement patterns to restore range of motion and reduce stiffness

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotations (Quadruped)
exercises.notes: Quadruped position, hand behind head, rotate to ceiling
exercises.instruction:
Start on hands and knees
Place one hand behind head
Rotate elbow toward ceiling
Feel thoracic spine rotating
10 rotations on one side
Switch hands and repeat
Keep hips stable
exercises.definition: Comprehensive mobility sequence targeting major joints and movement patterns to restore range of motion and reduce stiffness

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.notes: Sync breath with movement, articulate through spine
exercises.instruction:
Start on hands and knees
COW (Inhale): Drop belly, lift chest, look up
CAT (Exhale): Round spine, tuck chin
Move slowly, feel each vertebra
Sync breath with movement
10 complete cycles
Feel spine mobilizing
exercises.definition: Comprehensive mobility sequence targeting major joints and movement patterns to restore range of motion and reduce stiffness

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.instruction:
Half-kneeling position
Back leg extended, front leg bent
Squeeze glute of back leg
Lean forward slightly
Feel hip flexor stretch
Hold 60 seconds
Switch sides and repeat
exercises.definition: Comprehensive mobility sequence targeting major joints and movement patterns to restore range of motion and reduce stiffness

recoveryWorkouts.title: Yoga Flow Recovery
recoveryWorkouts.description: Restorative yoga sequence for deep recovery and flexibility

exercises.name: Sun Salutations
exercises.instruction:
Begin in Mountain Pose (Tadasana): Stand tall, feet together, arms at sides
INHALE: Sweep arms overhead, slight backbend, gaze up
EXHALE: Hinge at hips, fold forward, hands to floor or shins
INHALE: Lift chest halfway, flat back, fingertips on shins or floor
EXHALE: Step or jump back to Plank, lower through Chaturanga
INHALE: Press through hands, lift chest into Upward Dog
EXHALE: Lift hips, press back into Downward Dog - hold 5 breaths
Step or jump feet to hands, INHALE lift halfway, EXHALE fold
INHALE: Rise to standing, arms overhead, EXHALE: hands to heart center
Repeat sequence 5 times, finding a smooth rhythm
exercises.definition: Restorative yoga sequence combining dynamic movement with static holds to improve flexibility, reduce tension, and promote recovery through breath-work and mindful movement

exercises.name: Downward Dog → Pigeon Pose
exercises.notes: Square hips, fold forward, breathe into hip stretch
exercises.instruction:
Start in Downward Dog: hands and feet on floor, hips high
Hold Downward Dog for 1 minute, breathe deeply
From Downward Dog, lift right leg high
Bring right knee forward behind right wrist
Right shin can be parallel to front of mat or angled back (modification)
Extend left leg straight back, top of foot on floor
Square hips toward front of mat—use block under right hip if needed
Walk hands forward, fold chest toward floor
Hold Pigeon Pose for 1 minute, breathing deeply into the hip
Press back to Downward Dog, repeat on left side
exercises.definition: Restorative yoga sequence combining dynamic movement with static holds to improve flexibility, reduce tension, and promote recovery through breath-work and mindful movement

exercises.name: Warrior Sequence
exercises.notes: Strong legs, open hips, flow with breath
exercises.instruction:
WARRIOR I: Step right foot forward into lunge, back foot angled 45°, hips squared forward, arms overhead, gaze up. Hold 30s.
WARRIOR II: Open hips and arms to side, back foot turns to 90°, front knee over ankle, arms parallel to floor, gaze over front fingers. Hold 30s.
REVERSE WARRIOR: Keep legs as is, flip front palm up, reach back and up, back hand slides down back leg, side body opens. Hold 30s.
Flow back through Warrior II to Warrior I
Step back to Mountain Pose, repeat entire sequence on left side
Maintain steady breath throughout
exercises.definition: Restorative yoga sequence combining dynamic movement with static holds to improve flexibility, reduce tension, and promote recovery through breath-work and mindful movement

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.notes: Initiate movement from pelvis, articulate through entire spine
exercises.instruction:
Start on hands and knees: wrists under shoulders, knees under hips
COW (Inhale): Tilt pelvis forward, drop belly, lift chest and gaze, shoulder blades draw together
CAT (Exhale): Tilt pelvis back, round spine toward ceiling, tuck chin, push floor away
Move slowly—feel each vertebra articulate
Let the breath initiate the movement
Continue for 10 complete cycles
Feel spine mobilizing through full range
exercises.definition: Restorative yoga sequence combining dynamic movement with static holds to improve flexibility, reduce tension, and promote recovery through breath-work and mindful movement

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.instruction:
From hands and knees, sit hips back toward heels
Knees can be together (more back stretch) or wide apart (more hip stretch)
Walk arms forward, forehead rests on floor (or on stacked hands)
Let shoulders melt down away from ears
Breathe into lower back and sides of ribcage
This is complete rest—let go of all tension
Hold for 2 minutes, focusing on deep breathing
exercises.definition: Restorative yoga sequence combining dynamic movement with static holds to improve flexibility, reduce tension, and promote recovery through breath-work and mindful movement

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.instruction: Inhale 4, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4.
exercises.definition: Final downshift after yoga flow

recoveryWorkouts.title: Foam Rolling & Recovery
recoveryWorkouts.description: Self-myofascial release and light movement for recovery

exercises.name: Quad Roll
exercises.notes: Face down, roll from hip to knee, pause on tender spots
exercises.instruction:
Lie face down, place foam roller under thighs
Support body weight on forearms and toes
Roll from hip to just above knee
Move slowly, 1-2 inches per second
Pause on tender spots, breathe deeply
Roll for 1 minute on each leg
Feel quad muscles releasing
exercises.definition: Self-myofascial release sequence using foam roller to reduce muscle tension, improve tissue quality, and promote recovery

exercises.name: IT Band Roll
exercises.notes: Side-lying, roll from hip to knee, support with hands
exercises.instruction:
Lie on side, place roller under IT band
Support upper body with forearm and bottom hand
Roll from hip to just above knee
Move slowly, this area can be sensitive
Pause on tender spots, breathe through it
Roll for 1 minute on each side
Feel IT band releasing
exercises.definition: Self-myofascial release sequence using foam roller to reduce muscle tension, improve tissue quality, and promote recovery

exercises.name: Glute Roll
exercises.notes: Sit on roller, cross ankle over knee, lean into tight side
exercises.instruction:
Sit on foam roller
Cross one ankle over opposite knee
Lean into the side being rolled
Roll back and forth over glute
Focus on areas of tightness
Switch sides after 30 seconds
Feel glute muscles releasing
exercises.definition: Self-myofascial release sequence using foam roller to reduce muscle tension, improve tissue quality, and promote recovery

exercises.name: Lat Roll
exercises.notes: Side-lying, roll from armpit to mid-rib
exercises.instruction:
Lie on side, place roller under armpit area
Support with bottom arm and legs
Roll from armpit down to mid-rib
Move slowly, breathe deeply
Roll for 30 seconds on each side
Feel lat muscles releasing
exercises.definition: Self-myofascial release sequence using foam roller to reduce muscle tension, improve tissue quality, and promote recovery

exercises.name: Thoracic Spine Roll
exercises.notes: Hands behind head, extend over roller at tight spots
exercises.instruction:
Lie on back, place roller under upper back
Hands behind head, support neck
Lift hips off ground
Roll slowly over thoracic spine
Pause on tight spots, extend over roller
Feel thoracic spine opening
Roll for 1 minute total
exercises.definition: Self-myofascial release sequence using foam roller to reduce muscle tension, improve tissue quality, and promote recovery

exercises.name: Easy Walk
exercises.instruction: Light walk to promote blood flow after rolling
exercises.definition: Gentle walking to promote circulation and flush metabolic byproducts after myofascial release
formCues: Light walk at very easy pace
Allow body to integrate rolling work

recoveryWorkouts.title: Breathwork & Meditation
recoveryWorkouts.description: Recovery through breathing exercises and mental restoration

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.instruction: 4-count inhale, 4-count hold, 4-count exhale, 4-count hold. Repeat for 5 minutes.
exercises.definition: Structured breathing pattern that regulates nervous system and promotes calm through equal-duration breath phases

exercises.name: Deep Breathing Reset
exercises.instruction: Lie on back, 4-count inhale through nose, 6-count exhale through mouth. Focus on complete relaxation and letting go of tension.
exercises.definition: Extended breathing practice with longer exhalation to activate parasympathetic nervous system and promote deep recovery
formCues: Let go of tension with each exhale

exercises.name: Guided Meditation
exercises.instruction: Body scan meditation: focus attention on each body part, releasing tension as you go. Start from toes and work up to head.
exercises.definition: Mindfulness practice using body scan technique to reduce stress, improve body awareness, and promote mental recovery
formCues: Focus attention on each body part
End at head, feel complete relaxation
Allow mind to rest and recover
